sites.name: Kim Lien Relic Site (Sen Village - Uncle Ho's paternal hometown)
sites.event: The place preserving artifacts, documents, and the childhood living space of President Ho Chi Minh and his family.

sites.name: Hoang Tru Village (Uncle Ho's maternal hometown)
sites.event: The place where President Ho Chi Minh was born and spent his early years (1890-1895).

sites.name: Cua Lo Beach
sites.event: One of the most beautiful and bustling beaches in the North Central region, famous for its long sandy shores, clear water, and abundant seafood.

place.commune: Wards: Thu Thuy, Nghi Huong, Nghi Thu...

sites.name: Truong Bon Historical Relic Site
sites.event: The place marking the heroic sacrifice of 13 youth volunteers of the Steel Squad (Company 317) during the anti-American resistance war.

sites.name: Pu Mat National Park
sites.event: A world biosphere reserve, conserving the Saola and boasting majestic natural landscapes such as Khe Kem Waterfall and Giang River.

place.district: Con Cuong District (extending to Anh Son, Tuong Duong)

sites.name: Cuong Temple
sites.event: The place of worship for Thuc Phan An Duong Vuong, associated with the legend of the magic crossbow and the fall of the Au Lac state.

sites.name: Thanh Chuong Tea Island
sites.event: Lush green tea hills situated in the middle of a clear blue lake, dubbed the 'Ha Long Bay on land' of the Nghe region.

sites.name: Vinh Ancient Citadel
sites.event: A military citadel relic built during the Nguyen Dynasty (1804), witnessing many historical events of the Nghe An region.

sites.name: Ong Hoang Muoi Temple
sites.event: A famous spiritual tourism destination worshipping Ong Hoang Muoi (Quan Hoang Muoi) - the deity who bestows wealth, fortune, and fame.

sites.name: Tomb of Madam Hoang Thi Loan
sites.event: The resting place of President Ho Chi Minh's mother, located on Dong Tranh Mountain with the stylized shape of a weaving loom.

sites.name: Sunflower field
sites.event: The largest sunflower field in Vietnam, a famous check-in spot every year-end.

sites.name: Bai Lu
sites.event: Likened to 'Da Lat on the sea' with cool green pine forests running along the pristine coast.
